scenes.title: Sela's offer and warning
scenes.summary: Sela offers passage for two silver and refuses to row at night; she says she will return at first light tomorrow. She claims Saltmere flooded when the bell first rang forty years ago and recounts her grandmother's report of warm water.

scenes.title: Hymn pages in the flooded mine
scenes.summary: The party finds warm black water and hymn pages, one marked "M. Brand"; Teo identifies the handwriting as his sister Mira's. Vessa and Oren suspect Maren's involvement without confirmation; bad air injures Oren.

scenes.place: Shore below the drowned chapel, Gullwick
scenes.title: The fishermen's warning
scenes.summary: The party returns at dusk and visits the shore despite Sela's warning. A fisherman warns that the Kelp Mother takes children by the ankles, a claim the GM attributes to the fishermen.

scenes.title: The midnight bell
scenes.summary: The underwater bell rings twelve times and the humming is louder than two nights earlier; pale figures stand in rows on the submerged chapel floor, then vanish. The GM notes the choir clock at three of six; Vessa calls for the party to leave.

scenes.title: A plan to dive at low tide
scenes.summary: The party agrees to ask Sela for passage at first light and dive to the chapel at low tide in daylight; Vessa plans to buy rope and another lantern. Bram says Maren lost a brother to the bay; the party takes a long rest and returns to full health.
